<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/landing.ts -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and one PricingCard per plan. Axes: layout (grid, stack), columns, emphasis, billing
  (off: no toggle; monthly or annual: a toggle with that choice selected, and the prices of that period),
  density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { BillingLabels } from "./pricing-tiers.types";
import type { Plan, PricingCardLabels } from "./pricing-card.types";

export type PricingTiersProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  plans: Plan[];
  labels: PricingCardLabels;
  billingLabels: BillingLabels;
  layout?: "grid" | "stack";
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
  emphasis?: "auto" | "off";
  billing?: "off" | "monthly" | "annual";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import PricingCard from "../blocks/pricing-card.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import Switcher from "../components/switcher.vue";
import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.vue";
import { fitCols } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  plans,
  labels,
  billingLabels,
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "1-3",
  emphasis = "auto",
  billing = "off",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<PricingTiersProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [id: string], billing: [period: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :measure="(((layout as string) === 'stack') ? 'md' : 'default')"
  >
    <Group
      v-if="((billing as string) !== 'off')"
      gap="4"
      align="center"
      justify="center"
      class="flex-wrap"
      data-testid="billing"
    >
      <Switcher :label="billingLabels.label">
        <SwitcherItem :active="((billing as string) === 'monthly')" @click="() => emit('billing', 'monthly')">
          {{ billingLabels.monthly }}
        </SwitcherItem>
        <SwitcherItem :active="((billing as string) === 'annual')" @click="() => emit('billing', 'annual')">
          {{ billingLabels.annual }}
        </SwitcherItem>
      </Switcher>
      <Badge variant="default" size="default">
        {{ billingLabels.save }}
      </Badge>
    </Group>
    <Grid
      :cols="(((layout as string) === 'stack') ? '1' : fitCols(cols, (plans?.length ?? 0)))"
      class="gap-4"
      data-testid="tiers"
    >
      <PricingCard v-for="plan in plans" :key="plan.id"
        :plan="plan"
        :labels="labels"
        :emphasis="emphasis"
        :billing="(((billing as string) === 'annual') ? 'annual' : 'monthly')"
        :density="(((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'compact' : 'default')"
        @select="() => emit('select', plan.id)"
      />
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
